content: Berocca is a tablet that contains a specific combination of B group vitamins and Vitamin C. It is available in various countries, including Argentina, Australia, Austria, Finland, France, Ireland, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Portugal, Russia, Singapore, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, and the United Kingdom. Originally manufactured by Roche Pharmaceuticals, Berocca is now produced by Bayer following Bayer's acquisition of Roche Consumer Health in January 2005. Berocca is available in different varieties. The Original and Tropical versions come in packs of 10, 15, or 30 effervescent tablets. Berocca Performance is available in packs of 15 or 30 effervescent tablets, as well as 30 regular film-coated tablets. Berocca Performance features an enhanced formulation that includes B group vitamins, Vitamin C, magnesium, calcium, and zinc. The ingredients in Berocca Original include citric acid, sodium hydrogen carbonate, vitamin C, magnesium sulfate, mannitol, calcium carbonate, magnesium carbonate, flavoring, coloring agents (beetroot red and beta carotene), sodium carbonate, niacin, sweeteners (aspartame and acesulfame K), sodium chloride, zinc citrate, pantothenic acid, riboflavin, thiamin, vitamin B12, vitamin B6, an anti-foaming agent (polysorbate 60), folic acid, and biotin. It contains a source of phenylalanine. The active ingredients in Berocca Original and Tropical include: Thiamine hydrochloride (Vitamin B1) 15 mg Riboflavine (Vitamin B2) 15 mg Nicotinamide (Vitamin B3) 50 mg Pantothenic acid (Vitamin B5) 23 mg Pyridoxine hydrochloride (Vitamin B6) 10 mg Cyanocobalamin (Vitamin B12) 10 mcg Ascorbic acid (Vitamin C) 1000 mg Calcium 65 mg The active ingredients in Berocca Performance include: Thiamine hydrochloride (Vitamin B1) 15 mg Riboflavine (Vitamin B2) 15 mg Nicotinamide (Vitamin B3) 50 mg Pantothenic acid (Vitamin B5) 23 mg Pyridoxine hydrochloride (Vitamin B6) 10 mg Cyanocobalamin (Vitamin B12) 10 mcg Biotin (Vitamin H) 150 mcg Folic acid 400 mcg Ascorbic acid (Vitamin C) 500 mg Calcium 100 mg Magnesium 100 mg Zinc 10 mg Berocca is sometimes taken before consuming alcohol, as it is anecdotally believed to prevent hangovers. Similarly, it is said to alleviate hangover symptoms when taken afterward. When consumed in effervescent form, it provides a rehydrating effect. There is some evidence suggesting that B vitamins may help relieve hangover symptoms. Additionally, the sweet and fizzy solution of Berocca is often gentler on the stomach compared to other vitamin supplements in tablet form. All Berocca products are gluten-free and lactose-free. The product codes for Berocca are as follows: Berocca Original: AUST L 57605 Berocca Tropical: AUST L 57883 Berocca Performance (effervescent): AUST L 81974 Berocca Performance (film-coated): AUST L 82484 In Finland, the Berocca license code is Vnr 559591, while the code for Berocca Drink is unknown. In Malaysia, the product code is MAL 05092248X. The recommended daily dose for individuals aged 11 and older is one tablet per day. Each Berocca tablet contains 285 mg of sodium, which should be considered by individuals on a low-sodium diet. It is important to always read the product label and use the product as directed. If symptoms persist, consult a healthcare professional. Berocca has been widely advertised, particularly in Australia, where it gained recognition through television commercials in the 1980s and 1990s with the slogan B-B-B-B-Berocca gives you back your B-B-B-Bounce. A more recent marketing campaign for Berocca Performance in Australia, targeting students preparing for exams, uses the slogan Release the inner geek. In South Africa, a campaign with the slogan Beready Besharp Besomebody Berocca was launched. In the UK, long-running outdoor poster campaigns have used the slogan Stay sharp. Berocca has also received recognition, winning the Boots Vitamin Award for Best Energy Supplement in 2004, as voted by Boots customers.
